description: Replace mod-based sharding with a consistent-hash ring (virtual nodes) so removing one node only remaps that node's own keys
prompts: ring.go's HashRing picks a node with `hash(key) % len(nodes)` - removing or adding any node reshuffles almost every key. Implement a real consistent-hash ring with virtual nodes: NewHashRing(nodes []string, replicas int) places `replicas` virtual points per physical node around a ring, hashed via crypto/md5 over fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", node, i) for each virtual point. GetNode(key string) hashes the key onto the ring and returns the node owning the next virtual point clockwise (wrapping around). AddNode(node string) and RemoveNode(node string) update the ring in place.
name: add_go_consistent_hash_ring
